title: Dehydration
short: A long, warm work day and a thirst that never comes. Fluid shift is lying to you.
briefing: A packed day of experiments in a warm, dry module. In space, fluid shift turns thirst down, so you dry out without noticing. The water unit is empty: refill it, drink on a schedule, and make the right calls.

story.intro: The busiest experiment week of the mission. Commander Varga has you running three payloads back to back in the warm lab.
story.goal: Keep your hydration in the green until the end of the work day.

crew.text: Water unit's showing empty again. Reserve bags are in the locker by the hatch.
Nobody's logged a drink since breakfast. Thirst is a liar up here.
Good work on the payloads. Don't let the lab's heat sneak up on you.

events.text: Busy day of experiments ahead. The water unit shows EMPTY.
You don't feel thirsty. Fluid shift turns thirst down in space.
The lab module is hot and dry today: 34 °C and 28 % humidity.

decisions.title: No thirst at all
decisions.prompt: You've had only 300 ml since waking up, but you don't feel thirsty.

choices.label: Drink on a schedule anyway, every hour
choices.feedback: In space, thirst lies. A schedule keeps you ahead of it.

choices.label: Wait until you feel thirsty
choices.feedback: Fluid shift turns thirst down, so it arrives late, after you're already dry.

choices.label: Have a coffee instead
choices.feedback: Coffee does count towards your fluids, but one cup isn't a plan. Without a schedule, thirst still won't remind you in time.

decisions.title: Headache and dark urine
decisions.prompt: Mid-afternoon: a dull headache, and your urine is dark yellow.

choices.label: Drink 500 ml and rest in a cooler module
choices.feedback: Fluid restores volume, and cooler, less dry air cuts how much water you lose.

choices.label: Take a painkiller and keep working
choices.feedback: The headache is a symptom of dehydration. Treat the cause.

choices.label: Do the planned exercise session now
choices.feedback: Two hours of exercise while dry makes you lose even more water.

decisions.title: End of the day
decisions.prompt: How do you set up for tomorrow?

choices.label: Fill a drink bag and set hourly reminders
choices.feedback: Small habits beat good intentions. VITALS can log every glass.

choices.label: Skip it, you'll remember
choices.feedback: That's what you thought this morning.

actions.label: Refill the water unit from a reserve bag
Take an electrolyte tablet with water
actions.message: Salts help your body hold on to the water.

keySteps.label: Refill the water unit early
keySteps.why: No water within reach means no drinking. Fix supply first.

keySteps.label: Drink before you feel thirsty
keySteps.why: Thirst comes late in space. Drinking on a schedule keeps you ahead.

successText: Day complete, and you stayed hydrated.
failText: Dehydration got serious. The flight surgeon stopped your work for the day.
